 Chapter: First Division · Part IX · Suits Relating to Miscellaneous Matters
 Section: 110::Twelve years.

By a person excluded from a joint family property to enforce a right to share therein.
Period of limitationTwelve years.
Time from which period begins to runWhen the exclusion becomes known to the plaintiff.
